第9章 离开陈家村前往青玉宗（第1页）
这时，陈晓云温柔笑着问道：“爹爹，我们该离开了，师尊已经催促我回去宗门了。”陈明一听回过神来，笑着回答道：“嗯，爹爹这就来，离开之前爹爹吩咐你的事，你都办好了吗？”陈晓云温柔笑着回答道：“爹爹，我都办好了，爹爹要是以后想回来看看的话，
我在带爹爹和弟弟回来看看。毕竟我也是挺想念这里的生活的，陈家村的村长爷爷，隔壁的陈二雷叔叔，和其他父老乡亲对我们都很好。我就算以后成为一方强者，我也不会忘了这里的父老乡亲的。”这时，陈江海泪流满面笑着说道：“晓云，以后你爹爹和你弟弟，你可要照顾好他们。
要是想村长爷爷们了，常回来看看我们就行，你给我们留下的丹药，至少能让我们每人，都还能活个几十年的。在外面也要照顾好自己，受委屈了的话，就去找你陈风叔叔，他应该会帮助你的。要是他不帮忙的话，就回来和村长爷爷说，我替你教训这臭小子。”
这时，炼丹师协会一名中年男性，突然打了个喷嚏，顿时一阵巨大的爆炸声而来，被炸的黑头土脸的陈风有些不寒而栗说道：“妈的，谁在背后说我坏话，我这一炉丹药都废了。算了不管了，此事等丹药炼好后再想吧，真是可惜了这些药材。”
陈晓云温柔笑着回答道：“村长爷爷，晓云知道了，我要是有解决不了的事，我会去寻风叔的。”陈江海一听，带着泪水笑着回答道：“好好好，要是这臭小子不认你，等他回来看我不教训他。别以为成了个什么八品炼丹师，就不把他老子当回事了。
就算他修为比他老子我高，他也不敢说什么的。”陈明强装笑脸说道：“海叔，我替晓云谢过您的好意了，风大哥我们要是没有遇到天大的事，我们不会去麻烦他的。”陈娇带着泪水说道：“明哥，海叔这不是怕你们在外面受委屈吗？你可不能拒绝海叔的心意。”
陈力带着泪水说道：“是啊，就算明哥你不是陈家村之人，那你也是姓陈，在这里生活那么多年，你难道不知道海叔是什么人吗？风大哥就算是我陈家村出息最高的，那毕竟也只有他一人而已，我想就算你们真有事，他也不会做事不管的。”
姬云生一听在纸上写道递给陈明看后，陈明也明白了，强装笑脸回答道：“嗯，我知道了，要不是云生提醒，我都钻牛角尖了，我陈明在此谢过大家的好意。要是以后陈家村需要我的帮助，就算我没有能力，晓云和云生也会替我帮大家伙的。”
陈江海带着泪水说道：“好了，时辰不早了，你们该出发了！以后常回来看看我们就好，这里也是你们的家。”陈晓云温柔笑着说道：“村长爷爷，我们会常回来看看你们的。”然后拉起陈明和姬云生，就上去飞舟启程了，陈家村的父老乡亲们也是带着泪水，
大声送别三人。当飞舟渐行渐远后，陈娇带着泪水问道：“海叔，明明我们之中，就你最舍不得他们离去，你为何还如此着急让他们离去呢？”陈江海一听，收起泪水擦了擦后，笑着回答道：“好了，都各自回去吧！”众人一听，也不继续问下去了，毕竟他们也知道，
陈江海不会告诉他们答案，他们也能猜得出来。他们这一百多号人，哪一个不是和陈江海一样，都是舍不得三人离去，只是长痛不如短痛。就算三人离去，以后也会有再见之日，只是不知道是何时而已。

> Chapter 9 Leaving Chenjiacun and going to Qingyu Sect (page 1)
Chapter 9 Leaving Chenjiacun and going to Qingyu Sect (page 1)
At this time, Chen Xiaoyun asked with a gentle smile: "Dad, it's time for us to leave. Master has urged me to go back to the sect." Chen Ming came back to his senses after hearing this and replied with a smile: "Well, dad is coming right now. Have you done all the things that dad told you before leaving?" Chen Xiaoyun replied with a gentle smile: "Dad, I have done everything. If dad wants to come back to see you later,
I'm bringing my father and brother back for a visit. After all, I really miss life here. The village chief grandfather of Chenjia Village, Uncle Chen Erlei next door, and other fellow villagers are all very kind to us. Even if I become a strong person in the future, I will never forget the folks here. At this time, Chen Jianghai burst into tears and said with a smile: "Xiaoyun, you must take good care of your father and your brother from now on."
If you miss the village chiefs and grandfathers, just come back and see us often. The elixir you left for us will at least allow each of us to live for several decades. You should also take care of yourself outside. If you feel wronged, go to your Uncle Chen Feng. He should be able to help you. If he doesn't help, come back and tell the village chief, I'll teach this brat a lesson for you. "
At this time, a middle-aged man from the Alchemist Association suddenly sneezed, and there was a huge explosion. The black-headed and rusty-faced Chen Feng shuddered and said, "Damn it, whoever said bad things about me behind my back, my entire batch of elixirs has been ruined. Forget it, let's think about it after the elixirs are refined. It's such a pity for these medicinal materials."
Chen Xiaoyun replied with a gentle smile: "Grandpa, village chief, Xiaoyun knows, if there is something I can't solve, I will go find Uncle Feng." Upon hearing this, Chen Jianghai replied with a tearful smile: "Okay, okay, if this brat doesn't recognize you, I won't teach him a lesson when he comes back. Don't think that because you have become an eighth-level alchemist, you won't take him seriously.
Even if his cultivation level is higher than mine, he doesn't dare to say anything. Chen Ming forced a smile and said: "Uncle Hai, I thank you for your kindness on Xiaoyun's behalf. Brother Feng, if we hadn't encountered anything serious, we wouldn't have bothered him." Chen Jiao said with tears: "Brother Ming, isn't Uncle Hai afraid that you will be wronged outside?" You can't refuse Uncle Hai's wishes. "
Chen Li said with tears: "Yes, even if Brother Ming is not from Chenjia Village, your surname is Chen. You have lived here for so many years. Don't you know who Uncle Hai is? Even if Brother Feng is the most promising person in Chenjia Village, he is the only one after all. I think even if something happens to you, he will not ignore it."
After Ji Yunsheng heard what he wrote on the paper and handed it to Chen Ming to read, Chen Ming also understood. He pretended to smile and replied: "Yes, I understand. If Yunsheng hadn't reminded me, I would have been in over my head. I, Chen Ming, would like to thank everyone for their kindness. If Chenjiacun needs my help in the future, even if I don't have the ability, Xiaoyun and Yunsheng will help everyone on my behalf."
Chen Jianghai said with tears: "Okay, it's getting late, it's time for you to set off! Just come back to see us often in the future, this is your home too." Chen Xiaoyun said with a gentle smile: "Grandpa, village chief, we will come back to see you often." Then he picked up Chen Ming and Ji Yunsheng and boarded the boat to set off. The villagers in Chenjia Village were also in tears.
A loud farewell to the three of them. When the flying boat was getting further and further away, Chen Jiao asked with tears in her eyes: "Uncle Hai, you are the most reluctant to let them go among us, why are you so anxious to let them go?" Upon hearing this, Chen Jianghai wiped away his tears and replied with a smile.He replied: "Okay, let's all go home!" Upon hearing this, everyone stopped asking any more questions. After all, they also knew,
Chen Jianghai wouldn't tell them the answer, but they could guess it. Among the more than a hundred of them, none of them were the same as Chen Jianghai, who were reluctant to let the three of them leave, but the long-term pain was not as good as the short-term pain. Even if the three of them leave, there will be a day to meet again in the future, I just don’t know when.
